description: This file defines an abstract class BatchJob that implements a scheduled job interface for processing batch operations within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for managing tracking tables, batching data processing, and job lifecycle management.

classes.name: BatchJob
classes.description: An abstract base class for batch processing jobs within SuiteCRM, providing common mechanisms for managing batch data, tracking progress, and interfacing with the job scheduling system.

methods.name: setJob
methods.description: Sets the SchedulersJob object for the current job instance.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main execution method that handles the batch processing flow, including initialization, batching, and completion handling.

methods.name: getJobKey
methods.description: Abstract method that should return a unique key identifier for the job.

methods.name: setupTracking
methods.description: Abstract method to set up tracking data for the job.

methods.name: shouldRun
methods.description: Abstract method that determines whether the job should run.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Abstract method for initial setup before job execution.

methods.name: getAllIdsInGroup
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve all record IDs in a specific group.

methods.name: processBatch
methods.description: Abstract method to process a batch of record IDs.

methods.name: getTrackingTableName
methods.description: Returns the name of the tracking table for a given type.

methods.name: initTrackingTable
methods.description: Creates and populates a tracking table with record IDs.

methods.name: deleteTrackingTable
methods.description: Removes a tracking table from the database.

methods.name: updateTrackingTable
methods.description: Marks record IDs as processed in the tracking table.

methods.name: getIdsBatch
methods.description: Retrieves a batch of unprocessed record IDs from the tracking table.

methods.name: getGroupBatchInfo
methods.description: Retrieves batching info for a specific group.

methods.name: getBatchSize
methods.description: Determines the batch size, default or overridden.

methods.name: getNextBatch
methods.description: Fetches the next batch of record IDs to process, updating tracking appropriately.

methods.name: getUpdatedCount
methods.description: Returns the count of processed records in the current dataset.

methods.name: updateJobStatus
methods.description: Updates the job object with current data and re-queues it.

methods.name: markComplete
methods.description: Marks the job as successfully completed.
